title: The separate process reads a governed history under its roots, and reports what it refuses
note: Stage 2, S2-2. SG1 and SG2 remove the child's report of what the second readers refuse (AUD-022). SG3 to SG8 remove each step that hands the child the history's public roots, from the run to the child (AUD-023). SG9 to SG14 and SG18 remove rules of the restated authentication. SG15 to SG17 remove the roots the decision proof and memory trust read under.

mutations.name: SG1_the_child_drops_what_the_record_reader_refuses
mutations.rationale: a transition the second reader refuses is reported as a clean log by the separate process

mutations.name: SG2_the_child_drops_what_the_task_reader_refuses
mutations.rationale: a task record the second task reader refuses is reported as a clean log by the separate process

mutations.name: SG3_the_parent_does_not_hand_over_the_authenticator
mutations.rationale: the child reads a GOVERNED history with no authenticator, reads nothing, and refuses every governed run

mutations.name: SG4_the_parent_does_not_hand_over_the_role_registry
mutations.rationale: the child reads a GOVERNED history with no role registry, reads nothing, and refuses every governed run
